hook_text: Three expressions. Three different tools. One decision tree picks every time.
clip_script: Whenever you meet an expression to factorise, ask the questions in this sequence. Question one — always first: is there a common factor? Take it out before anything else. Question two: how many terms remain? The count points to the tool. Two terms: look for a difference of two squares, or a sum or difference of two cubes. Three terms: a trinomial — try the product-and-sum method. Four terms: grouping in pairs. Question three, after factorising: is every bracket itself fully factorised? That decision tree — common factor, count the terms, check the brackets — is the whole strategy.
visual_style: Flowchart animating branch by branch, each expression sliding down its correct path and snapping into factored form.
pacing: Crisp question-answer rhythm, accelerating as the tree completes.
